sents.zh: 我们学校的门口有一棵很大的树。
sents.en: There is a very big tree at our school gate.

sents.zh: 这棵树已经很老了，比学校还老。
sents.en: The tree is already old — older than the school.

sents.zh: 它很高，天热的时候下面很好。
sents.en: It is tall, and it is pleasant underneath when the weather is hot.

sents.zh: 所以每天中午，我们都在树下玩。
sents.en: So every day at noon we play under it.

sents.zh: 我和三个朋友常常一起过去。
sents.en: My three friends and I often go over together.

sents.zh: 我们有时候做游戏，有时候说故事。
sents.en: Sometimes we play games, and sometimes we tell stories.

sents.zh: 其中一个朋友很会说故事。
sents.en: One of them is very good at telling stories.

sents.zh: 他说的时候，大家都不说话了。
sents.en: When he tells one, everybody goes quiet.

sents.zh: 今天他说了一个很长的故事。
sents.en: Today he told a very long story.

sents.zh: 故事里有山，有水，还有一条龙。
sents.en: In the story there were mountains, water, and a dragon.

sents.zh: 我们听得很认真，因为故事太好听了。
sents.en: We listened closely, because the story was so good.

sents.zh: 后来老师走过来，说：“要上课了。”
sents.en: Then the teacher came over and said: "It is time for class."

sents.zh: 我们跑回教室，坐好，拿出书。
sents.en: We ran back to the classroom, sat down and took out our books.

sents.zh: 虽然故事还没有说完，但是明天还可以听。
sents.en: Although the story was not finished, we can hear the rest tomorrow.

sents.zh: 我很喜欢这棵树，也很喜欢这几个朋友。
sents.en: I love that tree, and I love those friends.
